about: Ivanovo A. M. Vasilevsky Airport is 7 km south-west of the centre of Ivanovo. A federal airport, operating since 1939. Operator and main handler: Tsentr Avia LLC.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Trolleybus No. 11: airport, Zagorodnaya St, Lezhnevskaya St, bus station, Ploshchad Revolyutsii, Sheremetevsky Ave, railway station. Runs from 7:00 to 20:00, interval 22–44 minutes. Taxi: Yandex Taxi, Vezyot, Maxim via apps. The airport is outside the city limits; it is better to book a taxi in advance.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Guarded automated car park with a barrier. First 10 minutes free, an hour 100 ₽, a day 400 ₽. Pay at the machine (cash without change or card), by QR code, in the Hippoparking app or on the website. After payment you have 15 minutes to exit.
